text:
vivian (People Ops): Heads-up: recruiting requests an exec-comp exception for a global candidate moving to US payroll. Need routing and cost-share options.

carlos (Recruiter): Candidate: Luca Moretti. Offer UK base  85,000 GBP + 12k relocation. Converted base ~ $130k -> above L5 cap. Hiring asks for $8k sign-on and a one-time relocation top-up. Wants May 2 start if approvals done.

mei (Hiring Manager): Luca is critical for scaling infra. We can absorb run-rate but prefer finance to cover relocation top-up from global hiring budget. Marking urgent.

oliver (Finance): Need clear split: run-rate (salary+benefits) vs one-time cash. Quick calc snippet:```base_usd=130000
benefits=base_usd*0.22
one_time=20000
```Attach headcount approval and GL strings.

sara (Legal): Note: payroll transfer will need tax review and immigration check. Recommend conditional offer: start "pending payroll & work auth". Also confirm relocation taxable treatment.

vivian (People Ops): Plan: open APPR-5210 to exec-comp + finance + legal. Ask for 48hr turnaround. If exec-comp OK with sign-on+top-up, we'll set start date "pending payroll conversion" and include conditional clause. I'll draft memo.

carlos (Recruiter): Uploaded offer + headcount note: /files/LMoretti-offer.pdf and https://docs.internal/luca-headcount. Candidate ok to push start if needed.

approvals-bot: Approval request created: APPR-5210. Status: pending. Routed to: exec-comp, finance, legal. SLA: 48 hours. Link: https://approvals.internal/APPR-5210

oliver (Finance): Provisional on one-time if recruiting maps relocation cost to GL RELOC-INTL-01. I'll confirm within 24hrs.

mei (Hiring Manager): If exec-comp needs more color, I can join a 10-min sync.

vivian (People Ops): Thanks everyone. Please react with :thumbsup: after you post your note on APPR-5210 so we can close the loop here.

(mei) :thumbsup: (oliver) :thumbsup: (sara) :eyes:
